result.summary: The page appears largely well-formed. No critical or major visual defects were found. A few minor cosmetic/content issues were identified: an empty profile avatar placeholder, redundant delivery-fee information on the Tokumaru card, and inconsistent metadata between restaurant cards (some show ratings, others don't).

issues.description: The profile avatar in the top-right corner is an empty gray circle with only a notification dot — no user image, initials, or icon is shown, making it look like a broken/unloaded image.
issues.suggestion: Display the user's photo, initials, or a default person icon inside the avatar circle as a fallback.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, '€0 delivery' is shown twice — once as a badge on the image and again in the metadata row below the title — which is redundant.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery indicator in only one place (e.g., keep the badge and drop it from the metadata line, or vice versa).

issues.description: Card metadata is inconsistent across sections: 'Fastest near you' cards show only delivery price (no rating or ETA in text), while 'Popular right now' cards show rating, ETA, delivery fee, and cuisine.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the information shown on restaurant cards (e.g., include rating and ETA on all cards) for a consistent scanning experience.
